origin.description: file_temp() returns the name which can be used as a temporary file.
origin.usage:
file_temp(pattern = "file", tmp_dir = tempdir(), ext = "")

file_temp_push(path)

file_temp_pop()

path_temp(...)

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: A character vector with the non-random portion of the name.

arguments.name: tmp_dir
arguments.text: The directory the file will be created in.

arguments.name: ext
arguments.text: The file extension of the temporary file.

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character vector of one or more paths.
Additional paths appended to the temporary directory by path().

origin.details:
file_temp_push() can be used to supply deterministic entries in the
temporary file stack. This can be useful for reproducibility in like example
documentation and vignettes.

file_temp_pop() can be used to explicitly remove an entry from the
internal stack, however generally this is done instead by calling
file_temp().

path_temp() constructs a path within the session temporary directory.
origin.example:
file_temp_push("/tmp/filedd461c46df20")

path_temp()
path_temp("does-not-exist")

file_temp()
file_temp(ext = "png")
file_temp("image", ext = "png")


# You can make the temp file paths deterministic
file_temp_push(letters)
file_temp()
file_temp()

# Or explicitly remove values
while (!is.null(file_temp_pop())) next
file_temp_pop()
